newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian December industrial output seen flat - IRS.
newsitem.headline: Italian December industrial output seen flat - IRS.

text.p: Italian industrial production in December is expected to be flat, leading indicators published by Italian private research group IRS showed.

IRS said factors likely to have a positive effect included a lower level of stocks and a slight easing of monetary policy, but these were offset by a scarcity of orders and a low level of confidence of Italian households in an economic recovery.
Expectations for the last quarter of 1996 confirmed the economic cycle was stationary, IRS added.
Latest official data showed Italian unadjusted industrial output fell 2.9 percent year-on-year in September after an August holiday month decline of 11.1 percent.
